scenarios.title: Data Events
mustHave: Status line for no-sensor / error reporting
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Enable subscribes to ReadingChanged; with no sensor present it reports 'No proximity sensor(s) found' and leaves Disable disabled.

scenarios.title: Polling
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Get Data polls GetCurrentReading; with no sensor it reports 'No proximity sensor found'.

scenarios.title: Display On/Off
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Enable requests display-off on proximity; with no sensor it reports 'No proximity sensor(s) found'.

scenarios.title: Background Proximity Sensor
mustHave: Task Registration / Task Status / Report Count / Last Report Timestamp / Detected output rows
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Register Task registers a background task only when a sensor exists; with no sensor it reports 'No Proximity sensors found' and Task Registration stays 'Unregistered'.
